product: ChopLab / おとひろい Windows Desktop
intent: Let a desktop user load a local source, chop it into pads, perform the pads, arrange a beat, and understand the current workflow at a glance.

reference.notes: The source captures are preserved in the canonical dirty checkout. The desktop capture is local evidence for appearance only; it does not prove Windows audio latency or Spotify provider behavior.

copy_policy.observed_copy: Transcribe the visible Japanese/English labels from the canonical ChopLab captures and retain their two-line machine-console rhythm.
copy_policy.authoritative_copy: Keep existing product copy from app/src/main/java/com/choplab/sampler/ui and use adapted desktop wording only when the capability is not available on Windows yet.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not replace the deck with a generic dark dashboard.
Do not claim MIC/DEVICE capture or Spotify audio import when the desktop adapter does not implement it.

visual_tokens.shape_language: rounded 6-13px panels, dark inset controls, orange active outline

regions.title: Five-step workflow strip
regions.purpose: Make the guided production stage visible and clickable.
visual_contract: Five evenly weighted controls connected by a thin line.
The active step uses an orange lamp/ring; unavailable future steps are visibly dimmed.

implementation.deviation: The desktop uses a wider horizontal strip, but keeps the same five labels, ordering, active orange treatment, and disabled-state meaning.

regions.title: Source input actions
regions.purpose: Give the user the same first actions as the Android deck.
visual_contract: Use large dark inset machine buttons on the cream deck panel.
The destructive action is orange/red and requires a second confirmation.

implementation.deviation: LOAD is functional for local WAV. MIC REC and DEVICE REC remain visible but explain that the first Windows slice does not implement capture yet.

regions.title: Source waveform and chop markers
authoritative_copy:
NO SOURCE
LOAD OR RECORD AUDIO
regions.purpose: Show source position, chop markers, and seek affordance before pad performance.
visual_contract: Black inset panel with green waveform, orange chop markers, and a pale playhead.
The waveform expands to the desktop workspace without changing the color semantics.

implementation.deviation: Desktop first slice supports local WAV waveform display and seek/play state; source capture and full marker editing remain follow-up capabilities.

regions.title: Coach message and source transport

observed_copy.text: ここだ、でPADを叩くと、その瞬間が入ります

authoritative_copy: ここだ、でPADを叩くと、その瞬間が入ります
regions.purpose: Explain the chop gesture and expose source playback/key controls.
visual_contract: Green text in a black status panel; source key is a compact stepper on the cream panel.

implementation.deviation: Desktop status text reports the supported local-WAV behavior when capture is unavailable.

regions.title: Four-by-four performance pad grid
regions.purpose: Select, preview, and assign chopped audio through the familiar 4×4 performance surface.
visual_contract: Sixteen dark rounded pads in a 4×4 grid.
Selected pad has an orange border; assigned pads carry a small green waveform/play glyph; empty pads show 空.

implementation.deviation: The desktop uses mouse and keyboard activation instead of touch/haptics, while preserving the visible grid, selection, assignment, and preview roles.

regions.title: Selected PAD editor
regions.purpose: Keep the selected pad's sound controls visible below the performance surface.
visual_contract: Cream parameter panel with a black title strip and three equally weighted parameter columns.
Values use large green monospace numerals and dark minus/plus or slider controls.

implementation.deviation: The first desktop slice exposes the same visible controls and local state; advanced trim/DSP behavior remains bounded until the shared model is ported.

regions.title: Stop, BANK selection, and production dock
regions.purpose: Preserve the deck's global safety action, bank navigation, and guided next step.
visual_contract: Dark machine controls sit beneath the cream editor panel.
The primary audition action is orange; the next workflow action is cream with a chevron.

implementation.deviation: Desktop may include Spotify controls in a separate header row so the original production dock remains visually dominant.

regions.title: Arrange step sequencer

observed_copy.text: ステップシーケンサー (PAD 01 キック)

authoritative_copy: ステップシーケンサー
regions.purpose: Keep the arrange stage visually and semantically continuous with the original deck.
visual_contract: A cream panel contains a left 4×4 pad selector and right 16-step lanes.
Active steps glow green; the playhead is orange.

implementation.deviation: Desktop uses a wider split layout and a local step state; recording/export semantics are explicitly marked as prototype or unsupported where not implemented.

completion_criteria: The desktop UI uses the original deck palette, typography rhythm, workflow strip, source controls, pad grid, editor, bank strip, and production dock.
The chop and arrange states can be reached locally and their implementation captures map every declared region.
The UI contract validator passes and all desktop tests pass.
Unsupported desktop recording, provider, and audio-quality boundaries remain visible and are not claimed as implemented.
